summary: Official MATSF national land/cadastre pages and an official Ambano context study were inspected. No anonymous Ambano parcel layer with a safe native ID, schema/CRS, and full polygon response was verified; no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Malagasy discovery query text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-1416-ambano.json under freshResearch.
requestOutcomes: All direct requests and outcomes are recorded in city-1416-ambano.json under requestOutcomes. National ministry pages were readable, but no local parcel service, feature schema, CRS, or ID+geometry route was exposed.
scopeLimits: The WUP point [-19.7756773892909, 47.0571663836759] was preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order.
No Ambano-local registry/cadastre map or procedure was evidenced strongly enough for registryFound=true.
National land/cadastre mandate and contextual reports do not prove citywide open parcel coverage.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No geometry was retained because native identity and a complete polygon response were not verified.
A zero hit, extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unavailable UI would not prove citywide absence.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
